limitations: Single seed, one plane/no-push dynamics case with 15 ms action buffering and training observation noise.
Replayed raw recorded commands at assumed uniform 50 Hz; hardware state, dynamics, sensor timing and contact are not reconstructed.
Only the actor velocity input is replaced with pre-action simulation truth in training units; each branch retains its own student latent/history as trajectories diverge.
The existing hardware recording lacks independent linear-velocity truth, so simulation improvements do not establish the hardware root cause.
No approved convergence/acceptance thresholds; reporting only. No training, parameter or source changes.
Hip/wheel targets reconstructed from actor output are requested targets before the actuator buffer, not a directly logged applied target.

methods.body_roll_pitch_angular_velocity_rms: sqrt(mean(wx**2 + wy**2)); post-step body-frame angular velocity
methods.hip_target_step_rms: sqrt(mean(diff(hip_scale * raw_action + default_offset)**2)); only consecutive selected steps without reset
methods.hip_velocity_rms: sqrt(mean(hip_velocity**2)) over both hips and selected policy samples; post-step joint signals
methods.requested_targets: Actor outputs transformed with saved action mapping; requested target before 15ms actuator buffer, not a measured applied target.
methods.spectral_method: Mean removal, Hann window, one-sided rFFT density normalized by fs*sum(window**2); band integral over bins 7<=f<=12 Hz. At least 100 contiguous samples; otherwise unavailable.
methods.tracking_xy_rmse: sqrt(mean((vx-cmd_vx)**2 + (vy-cmd_vy)**2)); post-step velocity and actual scheduled command
methods.velocity_estimate_errors: student estimate minus pre-action roa_true_velocity_b, in physical m/s; not post-step truth
